 Two days after the 2026 Ballon d'Or ceremony, another result was announced this Wednesday, October 28!
 The Ballon d'Or organizers revealed the result of the B.O.A.T. (Ballon d'Or of All Time), and the big winner is… Cristiano Ronaldo!
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Portuguese star beat Lionel Messi in this public vote pitting the two football legends against each other!
 The Ballon d'Or CR7 won in 2008, while playing for Manchester United, topped the poll. It finished ahead of Messi's 2012 award and another of the Portuguese star's triumphs, from 2017. The result puts the spotlight on the first Ballon d'Or of Ronaldo's career.
 Unlike the traditional Ballon d'Or, awarded following a vote by journalists, the B.O.A.T. is decided by the public and the fan community.
 And in this long-distance duel with Messi, CR7's supporters had the final say...
